description: footRoll -20: the heel takes 20, so the whole foot turns -20 about the heel (0, 0, -10). Offset from it (dy 8, dz 4): y' = 8 cos(-20) - 4 sin(-20) = 8.885622, z' = 8 sin(-20) + 4 cos(-20) = 1.022609, so z = -8.977391. The Limb is at IK, so its hand reaches the foot's ankle target: (4, 4, 0) + 0.1 * (P - (0, 8, -6)).
